title: Getting the science right
paragraphs: Sci-fi movies tend to capture children's imaginations and have long been part of students' excited chats in the schoolyard. But now a scientific journal has urged at least one sci-fi movie to be shown in class by science teachers.

Scientific papers published in the American Journal of Physics (AJP) and in Classical and Quantum Gravity have seen merit in the way the movie Interstellar portrays wormholes. Dr David Jackson from AJP said publishing this paper "was a no-brainer". He added: "The physics has been very carefully reviewed by experts and found to be accurate. The publication will encourage physics teachers to show the film in their classes to get across ideas about general relativity".

In fact, one of the executive producers of Interstellar was Kip Thorne, a professor of theoretical physics at the California Institute of Technology (Caltech). For him, films such as Interstellar, Contact and 2001: A Space Odyssey can inspire young people.

Blockbusters are improving when it comes to portraying scientific theories. An initiative by the US National Academy of Sciences has been putting proper scientists in touch with movie people to achieve a better result – which is vital in the internet age. Interstellar's director Christopher Nolan says: "Consumers have a lot more immediate access to information. If you go and see a film about a particular subject, particularly a true life story, you can go home and look it up on Wikipedia and see if the basic things portrayed in the film are true or not. The same is true of science in the films".
Professional scientists may no longer cringe in their seats when they watch sci-fi movies. Today, getting the science wrong is no longer an option.

vocabulary.entry: sci-fi /ˈsaɪ faɪ/ n. 科幻；科幻作品
vocabulary.example: Many children are big fans of sci-fi.
vocabulary.translation: 许多孩子都是科幻爱好者。

vocabulary.entry: capture /ˈkæptʃə(r)/ v. 激发；俘获
vocabulary.example: The story can capture children's imagination.
vocabulary.translation: 这个故事能够激发孩子们的想象力。

vocabulary.entry: imagination /ɪˌmædʒɪˈneɪʃn/ n. 想象力
vocabulary.example: Reading and films can enrich our imagination.
vocabulary.translation: 阅读与电影可以丰富我们的想象力。

vocabulary.entry: urge /ɜːdʒ/ v. 呼吁；敦促
vocabulary.example: Experts urge schools to use films for teaching.
vocabulary.translation: 专家呼吁学校利用影片辅助教学。

vocabulary.entry: merit /ˈmerɪt/ n. 价值；优点
vocabulary.example: The film has great scientific and educational merit.
vocabulary.translation: 这部影片具备极高的科学教育价值。

vocabulary.entry: wormhole /ˈwɜːmhəʊl/ n. 虫洞
vocabulary.example: The movie gives a vivid description of wormholes.
vocabulary.translation: 影片生动描绘了虫洞。

vocabulary.entry: no-brainer /ˌnəʊ ˈbreɪnə(r)/ n. 无需思考的事；理所当然的事【口语表达】
vocabulary.example: It is a no-brainer to support this useful method.
vocabulary.translation: 支持这种实用的教学方式是理所当然的。

vocabulary.entry: accurate /ˈækjərət/ adj. 准确的；精确的
vocabulary.example: The data in the film is scientifically accurate.
vocabulary.translation: 影片中的数据符合科学事实。

vocabulary.entry: get across /ɡet əˈkrɒs/ 讲解清楚；传达（短语）
vocabulary.example: Teachers use videos to get across difficult knowledge.
vocabulary.translation: 教师借助视频讲解难懂的知识点。

vocabulary.entry: relativity /ˌreləˈtɪvəti/ n. 相对论
vocabulary.example: General relativity is a key theory in physics.
vocabulary.translation: 广义相对论是物理学的核心理论。

vocabulary.entry: theoretical /ˌθɪəˈretɪkl/ adj. 理论的
vocabulary.example: He is a famous theoretical physics professor.
vocabulary.translation: 他是知名的理论物理学教授。

vocabulary.entry: executive producer /ɪɡˈzekjətɪv prəˈdjuːsə(r)/ 执行制片人（短语）
vocabulary.example: He works as an executive producer on many films.
vocabulary.translation: 他担任多部影片的执行制片人。

vocabulary.entry: blockbuster /ˈblɒkbʌstə(r)/ n. 大片；商业巨制
vocabulary.example: This sci-fi blockbuster is popular worldwide.
vocabulary.translation: 这部科幻大片风靡全球。

vocabulary.entry: portray /pɔːˈtreɪ/ v. 描绘；刻画
vocabulary.example: The movie tries to portray real scientific theories.
vocabulary.translation: 该影片力求还原真实的科学理论。

vocabulary.entry: initiative /ɪˈnɪʃətɪv/ n. 举措；倡议
vocabulary.example: This initiative helps improve movie science accuracy.
vocabulary.translation: 这项举措有助于提升影片的科学严谨性。

vocabulary.entry: in touch with /ɪn tʌtʃ wɪð/ 与……合作；保持联络（短语）
vocabulary.example: Scientists keep in touch with film makers.
vocabulary.translation: 科学家与电影制作人保持合作。

vocabulary.entry: access to /ˈækses tuː/ 获取途径；使用权（短语）
vocabulary.example: People now have easy access to online information.
vocabulary.translation: 如今人们可以轻松获取网络信息。

vocabulary.entry: look up /lʊk ʌp/ 查阅；检索（短语）【口语表达】
vocabulary.example: You can look up facts on the Internet.
vocabulary.translation: 你可以在网上查阅事实资料。

vocabulary.entry: cringe /krɪndʒ/ v. 感到尴尬；局促不安
vocabulary.example: Scientists cringe at wrong science in movies.
vocabulary.translation: 科学家会为影片中错误的科学设定感到尴尬。

vocabulary.entry: option /ˈɒpʃn/ n. 选择；可行做法
vocabulary.example: Ignoring basic science is no longer an option.
vocabulary.translation: 忽视基础科学已经行不通。
